newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Employment Dept jobs indicator rises.
newsitem.headline: Australian Employment Dept jobs indicator rises.

text.p: The Australian government's leading indicator of employment rose to minus 0.427 in April from minus 0.446 in March, the Employment Department said on Wednesday.

"The current revision of the...leading indicator shows that it has increased, albeit at a slow rate, in each of the five months since November 1996," the department said in its monthly release. "This points to an increase in the rate of employment growth later this year."
In its release, the department mistakenly labelled the latest month's data as March, but a spokesman said the number should be read as "April."
The indicator is an amalgam of seven statistical series, including vehicle registrations, housing approvals and job vacancies.
Since the early 1980s, it has consistently anticipated turns in the labour market -- beginning to rise or fall before employment does -- but with highly variable lags.
